purpose: Prevent AI-generation artifacts from being promoted as production authority.
rules: A bleed/registration PASS does not imply anatomy PASS.
Hands must be reviewed where visible; intentional gauntlets or closed fists are judged by plausible topology, not by requiring five visible digits.
Eyes must have coherent gaze direction for the authored pose; dramatic head turns do not excuse crossed or independently wandering pupils.
FX may occlude anatomy but may never create a second readable limb, hand, fist, thumb, wrist or joint.
Character identity must remain stable across the entire sequence.
Hard rejects block production promotion. Required cleanup keeps authority conditional until corrected and re-reviewed.
Runtime geometry issues are corrected by registration, not by redrawing otherwise-valid anatomy.
